summary: Tested driver email field in registration form (Bug 1) and Edit Profile modal (Bug 2). Both UI inputs render correctly with expected data-testids, placeholders, and accept typing. Backend persists email correctly in Mongo for PUT /api/auth/profile and POST /api/auth/register-with-invitation. Found and fixed a critical omission where /login, /me, /register-with-invitation, and another /me-like path built UserResponse without email=… — the email was saved in DB but never returned to the frontend, so openProfileModal always showed an empty email even for users that had one. 7/7 backend tests pass (4 new + 3 password_reset regression); 10/10 test_rides regression pass.

minor.issue: Line 410 uses convoluted short-circuit expression `(email or None) and email.strip().lower() or None` — works but hard to read; consider explicit `email.strip().lower() if email else None`.

action_items: None blocking — the missing email in UserResponse was fixed here. Main agent should verify the fix in /app/backend/routers/auth.py at lines 68, 104, 259, 451.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: 4 of 5 UserResponse constructions were missing email=… (login, /me, one intermediate handler around line 259, and register-with-invitation). Only PUT /profile included it. This meant the email persisted in DB was never surfaced to the frontend after login/refresh, making the 'Editar Perfil' modal always open with an empty email field. Fixed.
index.tsx is 22k+ lines — extremely hard to review. Recommend splitting into feature-oriented modules (driver auth, profile, rides, etc.).
Login form (auth screen) has no data-testid on username/password inputs — only on the submit button. Add data-testid="login-username-input" and "login-password-input" for testability.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates and cleans up TEST_reguser_* users and TEST_dupuser; test admin ends with email 'admin+profileput@test.com' persisted — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both email fields (register-email-input, profile-email-input) are wired end-to-end. To exercise manually: role-picker-driver → login admin/admin → click 'admin' chip top-right → 'Editar Perfil'. Backend regression suite: pytest backend/tests/test_email_field.py backend/tests/test_password_reset.py backend/tests/test_rides.py.
rca of the issue: The main agent implemented the frontend inputs and the DB persistence layer (email in Mongo doc, PUT /profile validation with unicity, register-with-invitation persistence) correctly. But when constructing UserResponse for login/me/register-with-invitation responses, the email= keyword was omitted, so Pydantic defaulted to None. Frontend openProfileModal reads currentUser.email, which came from those responses → always empty even when DB had the value. Fix was to add email=user.get('email') to 4 UserResponse constructions in /app/backend/routers/auth.py (lines ~68, 104, 259, 451).
